options.content:
**Purpose:** Outcomes of Admin document operations and retention batches.

**Audience:** Operators and support staff responsible for Admin documents.

**Decision supported:** Identify an operation with failures and check whether retention batches still complete.

panels.title: Document requests by outcome
panels.description: Cumulative attempts by operation and outcome. Expected rejections can be distinguished from application failures. Counts reset on process restart. An idle environment can have no series.

panels.title: Document retention batches by outcome
panels.description: Cumulative attempted batches for draft, audit, and idempotency retention. A batch that safely retains held items can succeed. Counts reset on process restart.
